infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Zondi uses your location while Protect Mode is active so your authorized patrol team can see your live position.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Zondi uses your location in the background while Protect Mode is active so your authorized patrol team can keep receiving your live position.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Zondi to use your location while Protect Mode is active.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Zondi to use your location in the background while Protect Mode is active.
